_comment: Secrets (connection strings, JWKS URI in non-dev environments) are supplied via K8s Secret / X__Y__Z-style environment variables, never committed here. Local-dev real values now come from the per-machine GlobalConfig file (see appsettings.Development.json's _comment_GlobalConfig note and appsettings.Local.json.example) rather than being hardcoded here.

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings:UserDb/Mongo:ConnectionString values. Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json; a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_UserDb: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or K8s Secret / ConnectionStrings__UserDb env var in non-dev environments. Never committed here.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or K8s Secret / Mongo__ConnectionString env var in non-dev environments. Never committed here.

Jwt._comment: Issuer/JwksUri point at kart-identity-service in every real environment.

Otlp._comment: Set via Observability__Otlp__Endpoint env var to enable OTLP export; empty = console-only Serilog + Prometheus scrape, no OTLP exporter.
